topics.title: Perishable Temperature Zones & HACCP Safety Standards
topics.objective: Segment supply chains into distinct cold corridors: Deep Frozen (-25°C), Chilled (0°C to 4°C), and Cool (10°C to 15°C).
topics.exercise: Define an environmental policy matrix mapping food products to mandated transit temperature corridors.

topics.title: IoT Temperature & Humidity Telemetry Gateways
topics.objective: Stream refrigerated fleet sensor telemetry with automated geo-fenced excursion detection.
topics.example: TruckTelemetry: { vehicle_id: 'GJ-01-992', temp_c: 3.4, gps: [23.02, 72.57], door_open: false }
topics.exercise: Build a telemetry ingestion handler detecting refrigeration compressor failure within 5 minutes of onset.

topics.title: Thermal-Aware Dynamic Route Planning
topics.objective: Plan delivery routes minimizing vehicle door-opening thermal degradation and ambient traffic delays.
topics.exercise: Optimize a dairy delivery route schedule prioritizing high-volume drops during cooler morning hours.

topics.title: Refrigerated Cross-Docking & Pre-Cooling Operations
topics.objective: Streamline rapid warehouse loading docks without exposing perishable pallets to ambient heat.
topics.example: DockStage: Unload -> Verify Core Temperature -> Transfer to Chilled Cross-Dock in < 15 mins
topics.exercise: Create an automated dock receiving workflow rejecting milk tankers exceeding 4.5°C upon arrival.

topics.title: Cold-Chain Unit Economics, Spoilage Rates & CAPEX Models
topics.objective: Model reefer fleet capital expenditures, diesel thermal unit operating costs, and spoilage reduction ROI.
topics.example: ROI = (Avoided Spoilage Loss - Reefer OPEX) / Reefer Fleet CAPEX
topics.exercise: Build a 3-year financial model comparing third-party reefer leasing vs direct cold-storage facility ownership.
